proofs.text: Open the board with the team fixture rewritten to schema 3; verify exactly 1 notice is on screen, that it names `purlin:status`, and that no tile and no table are rendered

rule_text: A payload written for another schema version shows one notice naming the command that rewrites it, and no tiles, no table and no tabs, rather than rendering fields it cannot read

tests.body:
def test_an_older_payload_shows_one_notice_and_nothing_else(browser,
                                                            tmp_path):
    payload = payload_named('team')
    payload['schema_version'] = 3
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload)
    notices = page.query_selector_all('.notice')
    assert len(notices) == 1
    assert 'purlin:status' in notices[0].inner_text()
    assert page.query_selector_all('.tile') == []
    assert page.query_selector_all('.tbl') == []
    assert page.query_selector_all('.tabs') == []
    page.close()
